critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal and correct: neg-token guard in scoreField + removal of the two loose single-token rules. Logic now guarantees that a *_name field cannot match an email/mobile/phone/address context, so empty source values no longer get replaced by a looser candidate.
setVal SELECT substring matching is still a latent risk if options with overlapping names ever appear (e.g. 'First Party' vs 'First Party (Buyer)'); not a current blocker.

FIELDS mapping now exposes correct behavior for party-name boxes exclusively via ['first party','name'] / ['name and address of the first party'] AND the names[] HTML-attribute hints (fpname/spname). This is a solid belt-and-suspenders approach.

rca of the issue: Fix (iteration_6 action item) is applied in /app/frontend/src/lib/bookmarklet.js: (1) first_party_name/second_party_name rules reduced to ['first party','name'] and 'name and address of the first/second party' only — the loose single-token fallbacks are gone, so an empty email/mobile value can no longer be substituted by the party name via a weaker match. Both independent mechanisms now enforce the strictness contract.
